notes.title: New content and features added - V 1.0.8
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Players,[/h3]

Over the past two weeks, we have analyzed data gathered from users, read your constructive input, and reviewed suggestions on how to improve the game. The latest version, 1.0.8, incorporates some of the requests made by players during this time.

[h2]Content and features:[/h2]
In this update, players now have the option to speed up movement. As you know, there are two docks in the game: an east-side dock and a west-side dock. From 6 am to 8 pm, you will now find a boat there, along with an individual offering transportation services for a fee of 5 pence (d).

Dock 1:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/b9fa73e5a05109ba25c40c1af69c3f187acbf9a8.png[/img]
Dock 2:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/2fcb05dfaa6d9f110ee3e9d2c40abe804d32b2e1.png[/img]

To use the service, simply walk down to the dock, engage in conversation with the boatman, pay the fee, and moments later, you will be transported to the other side of the city. This transportation works both ways, from west to east and east to west.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/8276b632106ab59210a26eab53388995e89b5659.png[/img]

Another content update in this version includes newspapers and family death events. For spoiler reasons, we won’t cover the specifics of family deaths here, but we can discuss the newspapers. There are now various stories and events described in newspapers nailed to the walls. These stories are based on real events from the plague outbreak and feature personal recollections recorded during that time.

Newspaper on wall:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/c23847ac3eb2657e4f74e57f13995186fea5af13.png[/img]

Newspaper opened:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43730556/35fff3e038bcbba3285f1aa4fe4de66ceb51989b.png[/img]

[h2]Fixes and updates:[/h2]
In addition to the new content, we’ve made some minor bug fixes and overall game improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed a closing bug on controllers for the GoG version of the game.
[*] Fixed a sound bug that continued playing if you didn’t have enough money to buy from the fish market (only on the Epic version).
[*] Updated intro animation and adjusted movement speed in the intro.
[*] Updated family requirements after day 11.
[/list]

We hope these improvements further enhance gameplay and provide a more satisfying experience for every player.

Please join our Discord channel to be part of our growing community and to stay in the loop about any news regarding the game: 
[url=https://discord.com/invite/mEqJJySDyw style=button] Discord [/url]

As always, these updates apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.
[url=https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/plague-london-1665-203017 style=button] Epic [/url]
[url=https://www.gog.com/en/game/plague_london_1665 style=button] GOG [/url]

[b]Thank you for being such a valued part of our community. [/b]
We hope you enjoy your continued adventures in the streets of London!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Update: UI Improvements and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We appreciate your dedication and valuable feedback! Your contributions are essential in our mission to refine and enhance the game experience.

We’re excited to share that version 1.0.7 is now live, featuring improvements and fixes:
[list]
[*]UI Update 1: The interface now displays items you find on the ground.
[*]UI Update 2: You can now see items you steal from corpses in your inventory.
[*]Inventory Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where the necessary amount of money would be deducted even if your inventory was full.
[*]Spawning Bug Fix: Addressed a bug present in the Epic version where quest items would not spawn after day 21.
[*]Camera Clip Fix: Fixed a camera issue that would cause it to clip to the river when exiting the apothecary.
[*]Updated Credits: The main menu credits section has been refreshed to include Steam users who assisted by reporting bugs and contributing with suggestions.
[*]Saving Events Optimization: Enhanced the saving process for quicker save progress.
[*]Overall Camera Adjustment: Adjusted camera settings.
[/list]

We appreciate your patience as we work to improve the game. 
Please join our Discord channel to be part of our growing community and to stay in the loop about any news regarding the game: 
[url=https://discord.com/invite/mEqJJySDyw style=button] Discord [/url]

As always, these updates apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.
[url=https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/plague-london-1665-203017 style=button] Epic [/url]
[url=https://www.gog.com/en/game/plague_london_1665 style=button] GOG [/url]

Thank you for being an essential part of our community. We hope you enjoy your continued adventures in the streets of London!

notes.title: Game Update v1.0.6: New Features, Fixes, and Temporary Cart Bug Solution!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you once again for your continued support and valuable feedback. Your insights are helping us improve the game, and we appreciate every contribution!

We’re excited to announce that the game has been updated to version 1.0.6, bringing several important updates and fixes: 
[list] 
[*] In-Game Menu: You can now access the city map from the in-game menu. 
[*] Spelling Fixes: Various spelling issues throughout the game have been addressed. 
[*] Updated Credits: The main menu credits section has been updated to include Steam users who helped by reporting bugs. 
[*] Cart Collider Bug: We’ve fixed a bug where the cart collider was causing issues. 
[*] Loading Bug: Fixed an issue where the cart collider would get stuck during loading. 
[*] New Loading Tips: Enjoy some fresh tips while your game loads. 
[/list]

Additionally, a more comprehensive update will be coming next week. The cart fixes in this version are temporary but were the quickest way to resolve the issue for now. A more permanent cart system fix is in development and will be released next week to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

Note: These changes apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.

Thank you for being a part of our community and helping us make the game better! 
Enjoy your adventures in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is Live: Gameplay Enhancements and UI Updates!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you once again for your continued support and for sharing your feedback with us. Your insights help us make the game better for everyone, and we appreciate your dedication!

We are excited to announce that the current active game version is now 1.0.5, which includes several important fixes and adjustments:
[list]
[*] Collider Adjustments: We’ve made several improvements to colliders for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] Graveyard Bottom Update: The graveyard bottom has been updated for better interaction and visuals.
[*] UI Behavior: When digging in the graveyard (bottom), the UI will now hide while you are in that area and reappear once you leave.
[*] Conversation Bubble Fix: Resolved an issue where the blue conversation bubble would get stuck with no text.
[/list]

We hope these changes enhance your gameplay experience. ❤️

Note: These changes apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.

As a reminder, if you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us. Your feedback is invaluable!

Thank you for being part of our community, and enjoy your adventures in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 - Updates and Fixes
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you all for playing our game, and a special thanks to those who report any issues, bugs, or strange behavior. Even if something isn't a bug, we are more than happy to look into anything that's reported, so please don’t hesitate to reach out if you suspect something is off.

The current active game version is now 1.0.4, and the fixes and updates it includes are as follows:
[list]
[*] Multi-collider interaction between carts, normal corpses, and wrapped corpses no longer causes a procedural bug.
[*] Some users were able to exploit the task generation system, which is now fixed.
[*] World adjustment system is no longer accessible.
[*] Markets and sellers no longer allow players to leave until the conversation is completed.
[*] Credits section updated.
[*] Save slot font size updated to display AM/PM.
[*] Notification added for blocked areas.
[*] Audio listeners disabled in the persistent game scene.
[/list]
We hope these fixes improve your overall experience. ❤️

Note: These changes apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.

Important: These fixes unfortunately do not affect save files from the previous version, so they are likely to be corrupted if the bug you experienced was procedural. Otherwise, your save files should be fine.

Thank you again for your amazing support, and stay safe in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Game Update - Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Dear Players,

First of all, we would like to express our gratitude to all of you who have played and enjoyed our game. ❤️
You are the reason we made this, so thank you very much for playing. 🤩

Over the past few days, some users have reported bugs, and we'd like to give a big thank you to those individuals. If you encounter any bugs or strange game behavior, please let us know so we can check and fix it.

As a token of appreciation, the players who reported these issues are now mentioned in a dedicated section in the Main Menu under Credits - Special Thanks. ❤️
Fixes in Version 1.0.3:
[list]
[*] Dual collider interaction between carts and corpses no longer causes a procedural bug.
[*] Older controllers no longer produce a double-click.
[*] Text clipping has been addressed (may still occur in certain situations).
[*] Bug when handing in tasks after purchasing items from the fish market has been resolved.
[*] Credits section updated.
[/list]
We hope these fixes improve your overall experience.

Note: These changes apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.

Thank you again for your amazing support, and stay safe in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/
